requirement:
删除独立的 SSO 登录注册模块，用统一的认证服务替代。
现有的 SSO、登录、注册三个独立服务维护成本高。
需要将认证逻辑统一到 auth 服务中，删除冗余服务。

details.name: ts-user-service
details.rationale: User management is closely tied to authentication; likely needs to align with the unified auth service for user registration and login flows.

details.name: ts-security-service
details.rationale: Security-related service may need to integrate with the new unified auth service for token validation and access control.

details.name: ts-gateway-service
details.rationale: Gateway routes authentication requests; must be updated to point to the unified auth service instead of separate SSO/login/register services.

details.name: ts-verification-code-service
details.rationale: Verification codes are often used in login/registration; may need to be integrated or coordinated with the unified auth service.

details.name: ts-admin-user-service
details.rationale: Admin user management may depend on authentication endpoints; needs to adapt to the consolidated auth service.

details.name: ts-notification-service
details.rationale: May send notifications for authentication events (e.g., password reset, account confirmation) and could be affected by changes in auth flows.

details.name: ts-contacts-service
details.rationale: Contacts are user-specific; may rely on auth for user identification.

details.name: ts-preserve-other-service
details.rationale: Similar to preserve-service, may rely on authentication for user-specific operations.

details.name: ts-cancel-service
details.rationale: Cancellation operations may require user authentication; could be affected by auth service changes.

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: Order management may require user identity from auth; changes to auth could affect order creation and retrieval.

details.name: ts-wait-order-service
details.rationale: Waitlist orders may need user identity; could be affected by auth changes.

details.name: ts-preserve-service
details.rationale: Preservation of tickets may require user authentication; could be impacted if auth endpoints change.

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: Handles other order types; may depend on authentication for user-specific data.

details.name: ts-rebook-service
details.rationale: Rebooking may require user authentication; likely to be impacted by auth consolidation.
